aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.name: PERZE
aboutPage.dataStorageMeta: And what never leaves your phone
aboutPage.dataStorageBody: Your transactions, accounts, and budgets live first on your phone (IndexedDB) and sync with your own Supabase project when you're online. Nothing is ever shared with third parties or used to train anything. If you self-host PERZE, that server is you.
aboutPage.operatorVisibilityMeta: What whoever runs this install can see
aboutPage.currencyStandardMeta: Why USD, ARS, UYU and not made-up symbols
aboutPage.currencyStandardBody1: The app's currency codes follow the ISO 4217 standard (USD, ARS, UYU, etc.) — the international three-letter identifier banks and exchange houses use.
aboutPage.currencyStandardBody2: The symbol ($, €, US$) is NOT part of that standard — it's a separate convention, and most of the world's currencies don't have a distinct, recognized one. Where a real symbol exists we show it (US$, AR$, $U for the Uruguayan peso); where it doesn't, we show the ISO code, which is the correct way to identify it without ambiguity.
aboutPage.madeWithBody: Geist Sans and Geist Mono, Phosphor icons, and exchange rates from BROU.
aboutPage.quote: The only thing that interferes with my learning is my education.

privacyNotice.who: This install of PERZE is run by one person, who manually approves every new access request.
privacyNotice.sees: Sees: your email, your country, and when you last used the app.
privacyNotice.neverSees: Never sees: your transactions, balances, accounts, or budgets. That restriction lives in the database, not a promise.
privacyNotice.noThirdParty: No third-party analytics: none of this ever leaves this install.
